content.value_statement: Accessibility gaps can block users and create compliance risk. This skill guides WCAG audits, ARIA fixes, keyboard testing, and inclusive design reviews.
actual_capabilities: Explains WCAG 2.1 POUR principles and AA or AAA contrast requirements.
Identifies missing alt text, weak contrast, unlabeled forms, and non-semantic HTML.
Provides accessible HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ARIA, modal, tab, accordion, and skip-link examples.
Lists automated and manual testing checks using axe, WAVE, Lighthouse, keyboard navigation, and screen readers.
Drafts accessibility statement structure with conformance status, feedback contact, known issues, and update date.
limitations: It does not run automated scanners or inspect live pages by itself.
It cannot certify legal compliance or replace a qualified accessibility audit.
Its examples may need adaptation for specific frameworks and component libraries.
It focuses on WCAG 2.1 guidance, not every regional accessibility law.

use_cases.title: Review a Feature Before Release
use_cases.description: Check pages for alt text, labels, headings, contrast, landmarks, and keyboard access before launch.

use_cases.title: Improve Inclusive Component Design
use_cases.description: Plan accessible modals, tabs, accordions, forms, focus states, and live status messages.

use_cases.title: Prepare Audit Evidence
use_cases.description: Build a practical checklist for WCAG, Section 508, ADA, and assistive technology review.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Page Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit of a single page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for WCAG 2.1 AA issues. Focus on headings, links, images, forms, and color contrast.

prompt_templates.title: Keyboard Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this workflow for keyboard access. Check tab order, focus indicators, skip links, Escape behavior, and focus restoration.

prompt_templates.title: ARIA Component Fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this custom component for ARIA accuracy. Recommend roles, names, states, keyboard behavior, and live region changes.

prompt_templates.title: Release Accessibility Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced readiness plan for a product release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a WCAG 2.1 AA audit plan for this release. Include automated checks, manual testing, screen reader coverage, and remediation priorities.

output_examples.input: Audit a checkout form for WCAG 2.1 AA readiness.
output: Missing visible labels on required fields.
Validation messages need programmatic association with each field.
Error summary should receive focus after failed submission.
The dialog needs an accessible name and modal state.
Move focus into the dialog when it opens.
Return focus to the trigger after closing.

output_examples.input: Create a test checklist for a marketing page.
output: Run axe, WAVE, Lighthouse, and contrast checks.
Test keyboard navigation at 200 percent zoom.
Verify headings, landmarks, alt text, and screen reader announcements.

best_practices: Start with semantic HTML before adding ARIA.
Test every important task with only a keyboard.
Combine automated scans with screen reader and manual review.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on placeholders instead of labels.
Do not hide focus indicators from keyboard users.
Do not add ARIA roles that duplicate native HTML semantics.

faq.question: Does this skill run accessibility scanners?
faq.answer: No. It provides audit guidance and checklists for tools such as axe, WAVE, and Lighthouse.

faq.question: Which standards does it cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on WCAG 2.1, with references to ADA and Section 508 audit preparation.

faq.question: Can it help with screen reader testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists practical VoiceOver and NVDA checks for page structure, forms, errors, and tasks.

faq.question: Can it write accessible component guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for modals, tabs, accordions, live regions, landmarks, and skip links.

faq.question: Is this a legal compliance certification?
faq.answer: No. It supports preparation and remediation, but legal certification requires qualified review.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
